<thought>The spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope spaced by ~1 Da with relative intensities roughly 100 : 12.5 : 1.1 : 0.08 …, which matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing several carbons. No 2 Da spaced pattern (Cl, Br) or other distinctive signatures are present, so the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
